description: Sagittarius zodiac sign: personality traits, strengths and challenges, love, career, decans and dates (November 22 to December 21).
answer: In Western astrology, Sagittarius is the ninth sign of the zodiac, a mutable fire sign ruled by Jupiter. It is traditionally associated with optimism, curiosity, candour and a hunger for freedom. The Sun is in Sagittarius from about November 22 to December 21. The exact dates shift by a day from year to year.

sections.heading: Sagittarius personality traits
paragraphs: Sagittarius is drawn as the archer, often a centaur, half human and half horse, with a bow pulled back towards some distant point. It is a lovely image for the sign's temperament: part animal energy and restlessness, part philosopher, always aiming beyond the horizon. Sagittarians are usually described as cheerful, frank and hungry for experience. They like big questions about meaning, belief and how other people live, and they would generally prefer an uncomfortable truth to a comfortable silence. The sign is associated with travel, higher learning, publishing and faith in the broadest sense, from organised religion to a personal code.

As a mutable fire sign ruled by Jupiter, Sagittarius combines warmth, adaptability and expansion. Fire supplies enthusiasm and an instinct to act on inspiration. Mutable signs close a season and are good at adjusting, so this one tends to move freely between places, people and ideas rather than digging in. Jupiter, the largest planet, is traditionally linked with growth, luck, generosity and wisdom, and it gives Sagittarius its famous optimism and its appetite for more: more knowledge, more road, more laughter. The result is a spirited, open-handed character who treats life rather like an expedition worth taking.

sections.heading: Sagittarius strengths and challenges
paragraphs: Few signs are better company on a bad day. Sagittarius brings humour, perspective and a genuine belief that things can improve, which can lift a whole room. It is honest to a fault, generous with its time and ideas, and unusually open to people unlike itself. Curiosity is a real strength here: Sagittarians often learn languages, read across subjects and ask the question everyone else was thinking. They adapt quickly to new places and tend to recover from setbacks fast, treating a failure as a story rather than a verdict. Their enthusiasm for teaching and sharing what they know can be infectious.

The archer sometimes forgets that the arrow lands somewhere. Sagittarian bluntness can wound, especially when it arrives as a joke, and the sign can be slow to notice the hurt. Restlessness may turn into a pattern of overpromising, starting plans with gusto and leaving others to finish them. Commitment of any kind, from a lease to a relationship, can feel like a cage, so some Sagittarians keep one foot out of the door. There can also be a preachy streak, a certainty that their philosophy is the right one. And optimism, pushed too far, can become carelessness with details, time or money.

sections.heading: Sagittarius in love and relationships
paragraphs: In love Sagittarius tends to be warm, playful and adventurous. It offers fun, honesty and a sense that life together will be bigger than life apart, with trips, ideas and plenty of laughter. Sagittarius is often attracted to people who interest it intellectually or who come from a different background, and it usually wants a partner who is also a friend and travelling companion. Above all it needs space: room to pursue its own interests, see its own friends and change its mind, without that being read as rejection.

Trouble usually starts when freedom and closeness seem to compete. A partner who wants regular reassurance may feel that Sagittarius is always halfway to the next adventure, while Sagittarius may feel hemmed in by routine and expectations. Its candour can also land as carelessness in tender moments. What helps is building freedom into the relationship rather than against it: shared adventures, separate interests that are welcomed, and plans for the future that feel exciting rather than confining. Sagittarius can help by saying out loud that it is staying, and by softening the delivery of hard truths.

sections.heading: Sagittarius at work
paragraphs: Sagittarius tends to thrive in work that offers variety, meaning and room to roam. It brings vision, enthusiasm and a talent for explaining big ideas simply, which suits teaching, lecturing, publishing, journalism, travel and tourism, law, outdoor work, international business, coaching and entrepreneurial ventures. As a leader it is usually inspiring and informal, painting a picture of where the team is going and trusting people to get there their own way. It works well with freedom and badly under micromanagement, endless meetings or rigid procedure that seems to exist for its own sake.

The weak spot is follow-through. Sagittarius may commit to too much, lose interest once the exciting phase is over, or skate past details that later matter. Deadlines can feel like suggestions. With money, Jupiter's generosity and optimism can mean spending freely on experiences, gifts and travel, or backing a hopeful idea without reading the small print. Pairing up with a detail-minded colleague, breaking big goals into short milestones, and keeping a simple budget that sets aside money for adventures can let Sagittarius keep its freedom without paying for it later.

sections.heading: Growth and the three Sagittarius decans
paragraphs: For Sagittarius, growth tends to come from depth as well as distance. It is easy to keep searching for the next horizon; the richer move is sometimes to stay with one place, one practice or one person long enough to know it well. Try finishing a project before starting the next, and notice how that feels. In conversation, practise asking one more question before offering an opinion, and check whether a joke has landed as intended. Commitments can be chosen freely, which makes them expressions of freedom rather than threats to it. Keep the optimism and the appetite for meaning, but let them be tested against detail, patience and other people's needs as well as your own.

Sagittarius divides into three decans of ten degrees each. The first, roughly November 22 to December 1, belongs to Jupiter; the second, about December 2 to December 11, to Mars; and the third, around December 12 to December 21, to the Sun. Each has its own page, and every Sagittarius birthday links to its decan.

faq.question: Why is Sagittarius so blunt?
faq.answer: Sagittarius is linked with truth-seeking and candour, and it often assumes others value honesty as much as it does. It rarely means to hurt. The bluntness usually comes from enthusiasm and speed rather than malice, and it tends to soften when Sagittarius pauses to consider how the words will be received.

faq.question: Who is Sagittarius most compatible with?
faq.answer: Sagittarius is often described as getting on easily with fellow fire signs Aries and Leo, who share its energy and boldness. The air signs Libra and Aquarius suit its love of ideas and independence. Gemini, the opposite sign, can be a lively and talkative match. A full chart comparison gives the fuller picture.

faq.question: What are the dates for Sagittarius?
faq.answer: About November 22 to December 21. The Sun's entry into each sign moves by a day or so between years, so birthdays at either end are cusp dates; the zodiac sign calculator settles them for a specific year.

faq.question: What are the three Sagittarius decans?
faq.answer: The first decan (0° to 9°) is linked with Jupiter, the second (10° to 19°) with Mars and the third (20° to 29°) with the Sun, following the rulers of the fire signs in zodiac order.
